title: G9: Editor stage with light CodeMirror 6, slot/region/file modes, STE error translator (L)
description:
An editor stage inside lessons using light CodeMirror 6 (not Monaco; see SIE-92f145).
Acceptance:
- Lesson scenes can use slot (one line), region (a block) or file modes.
- Only the allowed range is editable.
- Assembler errors are translated to STE messages by the error translator.
- Bundle size stays small.
right_now_summary: The team is building a lightweight CodeMirror 6 editor with restricted editing and translated assembler errors.
